verdict.rationale: Linear publishes an official TypeScript SDK exposing its GraphQL schema with strongly typed models (linear-docs-53, linear-docs-89, linear-docs-93), backed by full GraphQL API docs, introspection, published schema SDL, OAuth2/API key auth, rate limits, and deprecation policy (linear-supp-graphql-introspection, linear-supp-apollo-explorer, linear-supp-rate-limits, linear-supp-deprecations, linear-docs-99, linear-docs-50). This gives AI-native developers a solid, well-documented official SDK to build against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration (e.g., GitHub stars, community usage reports) of the SDK itself beyond official docs, and SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript.
